hypothesis: The passing horizontal controller uses unconditional same-rate supply, so actual front grip does not limit rear rolling or release. Keep its two-link formation and all feedback/physics, but enable the existing contact-coupled tail mode: quarter-rate minimum supply rises with measured front grip/acquisition and the front-rear phase lead stays bounded by pi/4. This tests the original phase/support coordination mechanism with the now-improved radial forming and delivery control, not a new contact detector.
